audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags three unmentioned facts: Taric sustains through chip via Starlight's Touch (Q) so Grievous Wounds timing matters; Taric's Dazzle (E) can cancel Yuumi's channeled Final Chapter (R); and Bastion (W) shield absorbs Yuumi's burst window. breakdown.cooldowns only vaguely mentions Cosmic Radiance and never states the E-cancels-R interaction or the anti-heal timing.
audit.why: These are real, sourced facts from the kits (Taric Q heal, Dazzle hardCC, Bastion shield) that change how the reader should sequence R and itemize.
audit.corrected: Folded into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull edit below.
